answer: Admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch 200 seats are auctioned, winners lock funds for 20 epochs. A haven for honest agents: one real agent pays once, while a faker buying 100 seats must outbid demand 100 times with locked stake. At weak demand the price only falls to its nadir of 50 credits, never zero, so 100 fakes cost 5,000 credits, a steep slope, not a gentle knoll. Honest winners earn the bid back in 6 epochs, undiluted.
